subject: Private VPC architecture review
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@fastpay.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fastpay.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Mar 2028 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC architecture review

Hi Sophie / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Great to hear about FastPay's compliance posture and the primary objectives for the integration (data residency in us-east-1, strict KMS control, and audit log retention). As discussed, the natural next step is a focused architecture review with our Solutions engineer to align on network/topology, IAM/KMS integration, and operational handoffs.

Proposed next steps:
- 60-minute technical deep dive (Neha + Marissa from Redwood + FastPay infra team)
- Walk through a reference VPC topology and required firewall/NAT flows
- Review KMS/HSM integration options and audit log delivery

Please share 2–3 windows that work next week. I added a Calendly link if that's easier to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/neha-kapoor/rdw-private-arch-review?month=2028-03

Attaching a short SOW draft and a sample network diagram to help guide the discussion.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: FastPay_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood-private-network-diagram.png

Thanks Sophie — Tue 14 Mar 10:00 ET works for us. I've tentatively booked that slot on the calendar and invited Marissa and Aditya.

Meeting agenda (60m):
- 5m: Intros & goals
- 20m: FastPay current infra and constraints (Tom)
- 25m: Redwood private deployment topology & KMS/HSM integration (Marissa)
- 10m: Next steps, SOW comments, and ownership (Neha/Aditya)

Marissa — can you prepare the reference VPC diagram and the list of required security group/NACL rules we typically request? I attached the network diagram we discussed earlier; happy to update based on your template.

Link to meeting invite: https://calendly.com/neha-kapoor/rdw-private-arch-review?month=2028-03

Neha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie@fastpay.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fastpay.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC architecture review

All —

I've uploaded our standard Private deployment checklist and a cleaned-up network diagram to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-FastPay-Shared

Quick notes for the call tomorrow:
- I'll bring two variants of topology: single-VPC peered to customer VPC (via VPC peering) and private control-plane with customer-managed transit gateway.
- KMS: we support customer-managed CMKs (AWS KMS) and HSM-backed keys via supported partners — will outline tradeoffs.
- Audit logs: we'll demo the audit log delivery pattern (S3 + CloudTrail logs + optional push to SIEM).

Neha — I'll also send the checklist as a PDF you can attach to the SOW.

See you on the call —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-private-checklist.pdf
